paper_metadata.title: Effects of returns on composition, microstructure and mechanical properties of GH4169 superalloy

evidence.quote: effects of returns proportion on alloy composition, microstructure and compression properties of superalloy GH4169 were studied

mechanisms.name: grain boundary pinning by Laves phase

evidence.quote: the Laves phase, distributed in the grain boundary and interdendritic regions, prevents the slide or movement of dislocation. The increased accumulation degree and raised volume fraction of Laves enhance the pinning effect of grain boundary, resulting in the increase of yield strength.
